name: GetM1Data v2
summary: This EA is a data extraction utility that collects and exports M1 (1-minute) bar data from MetaTrader 5. It does not open any trades but instead gathers historical or live minute-level OHLCV data for external analysis or backtesting purposes.
summary_zh: 该EA是一款数据提取工具，用于从MetaTrader 5中收集和导出M1（1分钟）K线数据。它不执行任何交易操作，而是采集历史或实时的分钟级OHLCV数据，供外部分析或回测使用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本质上是一个数据采集工具而非交易策略。它通过遍历M1时间周期的K线数据，提取开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价和成交量等信息。入场和出场条件在此不适用，因为该EA不进行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。其主要功能是将采集到的M1数据以某种格式（如CSV或自定义格式）输出，便于交易者在其他平台或工具中进行量化分析。该工具对于需要高质量逐笔数据进行策略开发的交易者非常有价值。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is fundamentally a data collection tool rather than a trading strategy. It iterates through M1 timeframe bar data to extract open, high, low, close, and volume information. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trades. Position sizing and money management are also not applicable. Its primary function is to output the collected M1 data in a structured format (such as CSV) for traders to perform quantitative analysis on external platforms. This tool is valuable for strategy developers who require high-quality minute-level data for backtesting and research. The utility nature means it focuses on data accuracy and export reliability rather than market timing.

parameters.name: StartBar
parameters.description: 起始K线索引，0表示最新K线

parameters.name: EndBar
parameters.description: 结束K线索引，定义数据采集范围
parameters.description_en: End bar index defining data collection range

parameters.name: OutputFormat
parameters.description: 数据输出格式，如CSV或文本
parameters.description_en: Data output format, e.g. CSV or text

parameters.name: Symbol
parameters.description: 交易品种，默认为当前图表品种
parameters.description_en: Trading symbol; default is current chart symbol

pros: 专注于M1数据采集，为量化策略开发提供高精度数据基础
不涉及交易操作，运行安全无资金风险
可作为数据预处理管道，与其他分析工具无缝集成
pros_en: Focused on M1 data collection, providing high-precision data foundation for quantitative strategy development
No trading operations involved, safe to run with zero financial risk
Can serve as a data preprocessing pipeline integrated seamlessly with other analysis tools
cons: 功能单一，仅支持M1周期数据采集，缺乏多时间框架支持
缺乏数据完整性校验机制，可能输出缺失或异常数据
无图形界面或进度指示，用户难以监控数据采集状态
cons_en: Single-function utility, only supports M1 timeframe data collection without multi-timeframe support
Lacks data integrity validation, potentially outputting missing or anomalous data
No GUI or progress indicator, making it difficult for users to monitor data collection status
improvements: 增加多时间框架支持（M5/M15/H1等），提升数据采集灵活性
添加数据完整性校验和缺失数据填补机制
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe support (M5/M15/H1 etc.) to enhance data collection flexibility
Implement data integrity validation and missing data interpolation mechanisms

risk_points: 长时间运行可能消耗大量内存和磁盘空间
输出文件路径若配置不当可能导致数据覆盖
risk_points_en: Extended runtime may consume significant memory and disk space
Misconfigured output file path may lead to data overwriting
